result.summary: I found 1 visual issue: a low-contrast promotional banner that is hard to read. No other obvious broken UI elements were present beyond the allowed partially visible carousel items and bottom-cutoff content.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and the smaller coupon details) is very low-contrast against the pale green background, making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast by using a darker text color or a slightly stronger banner background tint to improve readability.
